tabs.title: Responding to the Invitation
tabs.description: Use what the message tells you.

questions.q: Why were Sofia's first weeks in Galway difficult?
choices: She could not find the language school.
Her aunt did not want her to stay.
She knew no one and found the weather colder than expected.
All her friends had moved to another town.
questions.explanation: Paragraph 1 of the A2 email supports the answer through the writer's invitation, activities or personal circumstances.

questions.q: How has Sofia's everyday life improved since September?
choices: She has stopped attending the language course.
She has found friends and often cooks with them.
She now works full-time in a hospital.
Her family has moved to the same town.
questions.explanation: Paragraph 1 of the A2 email supports the answer through the writer's invitation, activities or personal circumstances.

questions.q: Why is the photography exhibition a good idea for Noah?
choices: Noah has asked her to buy a train ticket.

questions.q: What is special about the man in Sofia's favourite photo?

choices: The meeting cannot happen without a full day.

questions.q: Which reply would best answer Sofia's invitation?
choices: Send a photo without mentioning Sunday.
